prior_passes.notes: Could not source a specific named public project matching 'Cairo Ring–Port Said Gas Pipeline' (130km) despite an extensive search: the Ministry of Petroleum's official 'national gas grid lines' PDF (2020, https://www.petroleum.gov.eg/ar-eg/gas-and-petrol/distribution-marketing-transporting/Documents/2020خطوط_الشبكة_القومية_للغازات_الطبيعية.pdf) is prose-only and names no line-by-line projects; a trade-press '39 projects' list (petro-news.com/95212/) and a '16,000km' list (youm7.com) both enumerate ~9 named national gas trunks built 2014-2023 with none matching this name/length; GASCO's own site (gasco.com.eg/gas-grid) gives only grid-wide totals, not a project list; multiple Arabic-language searches for 'الحلقي'/'الدائري' (ring) + بورسعيد, and for an Ismailia–Port Said line, returned only adjacent-but-distinct projects: 'Duplication of the Gamal–Damietta gas line' (42in, 50km, Damietta/Port Said governorates, presidency.eg) and 'Development of the West Port Said gas-processing station' (presidency.eg) — neither matches this PID's length or the 'Cairo Ring' descriptor. Best working hypothesis (UNVERIFIED): a segment of a Cairo-area gas ring-main / distribution hub extended east toward Port Said, plausibly related to or overlapping the same corridor as the El Tina–Abu Sultan–NAC trunk (P8002) which itself crosses Port Said governorate — but no source ties this specific 130km figure or a 'Cairo Ring' name to a documented project. Recommend a follow-up pass once WebSearch quota resets, or checking GASCO/EGAS's internal project archive directly; leaving as ROUTE_PARTIAL (corridor-only, no endpoints) rather than guessing coordinates.

Still unresolved after a second search pass (fresh WebSearch/WebFetch budget). No public source names a project called 'Cairo Ring-Port Said Gas Pipeline' or ties a 130km line to that name -- reconfirms the prior pass's exhaustive negative result (Ministry of Petroleum 2020 grid PDF, the '39 projects'/'16,000km' trade-press lists, GASCO's own site, Arabic 'الحلقي/الدائري' + بورسعيد searches). NEW this pass: Egypt Oil & Gas's published 'Egypt Gas Transmission Infrastructure Map' (2017, independent trade-press source, not GEM) was downloaded and visually inspected at full resolution. It shows two distinct corridors east of Cairo: (1) a BLACK 'Under Construction Pipeline' (as of 2017) running El Tina/Gamil -> Abu Soltan -> N Sinai -> N Sinai Cement & Industrial Area, heading further east into Sinai toward Arish -- this matches the existing GEM entity P8002 (El Tina-Abu Sultan-NAC), not P8020; and (2) a separate GRAY 'Existing Pipeline' corridor running from the Greater Cairo distribution network (near 10th of Ramadan City / Abu Zabi, east of Cairo) through El Tina up the coast to Port Said city / Port Fouad -- geographically and by length (map distance is plausibly in the 120-150km range) a much better candidate match for 'Cairo Ring-Port Said' than anything found in the first pass. HOWEVER the map is schematic: it labels area names (10th of Ramadan, Abu Zabi, El Tina, Port Said) and generic station icons, not a named project or a specific facility at either end, so I still cannot pick one confident, sourced facility name to geocode per standing rule 2 (never fabricate/infer coordinates). Also checked and ruled out as NOT a match: the 'Sinai Gas Company / GASCO' contract to lay 35km of distribution network in the East Port Said industrial zone (dotenerg.com, aljournalalektsady.com, ccsr-eg.net, cashnewseg.com, all reporting the same ministry announcement) -- this is a city-gas distribution project, wrong scale/purpose, not a 130km transmission trunk. Recommend: if a further pass is attempted, try GASCO's/EGAS's annual report PDFs (which sometimes list named trunk projects with commissioning years) or Egypt Oil & Gas's underlying GIS/map data provider directly, rather than search engines, since the project appears to exist physically (per the map) but isn't named as such in any indexed public document.
